window.const: today through today+30 local calendar dates, inclusive; missing due dates since the current schedule revision are filled

dstGap.const: advance to the first valid instant after the gap; preserve the intended local date and time

dstOverlap.const: choose the earlier UTC instant (the earlier offset)

interval.const: frequency 'interval': a local date D matches when D >= anchorDate and the whole calendar days from anchorDate to D are a multiple of everyDays (1..36500)

window.const: startDate and endDate (both optional, inclusive, any non-prn frequency): D matches only when (startDate is null or D >= startDate) and (endDate is null or D <= endDate); generation starts no earlier than startDate and stops after endDate

timeZonePolicy.const: Use only the schedule's explicitly stored IANA zone. Never infer a zone or local date from a legacy UTC timestamp.

snapshot.const: ScheduleSnapshotV1 is immutable and contains version, pillName, dosage, frequency, sorted frequencyDays, hour, minute, timeZone, profileId, and profileName.

snapshotV3.const: A routine that is an interval or has a startDate or endDate writes ScheduleSnapshotV3 (snapshotVersion 3): every V1 field plus everyDays, anchorDate, startDate and endDate (nullable). Every other routine keeps ScheduleSnapshotV1 byte for byte. Version 2 is reserved for the app's device-local snapshots. Occurrence keys are unchanged: frequency is not part of the key.
